text: A floating island with a tomato patch and a white bunny-ish creature. Says Day 3 already, odd for a first launch. Prompt says tap the ripe crop, so I'll tap the tomatoes.

Harvested: coins 10->14, XP 3/60. Bunny hopped onto the empty plot. Now it asks to tap the farm to sow; there's also a Sow/Water/Harvest bar at the bottom with Sow highlighted. I'll tap the farm itself.
Seeds are in the rows. Sky is turning pink - a day seems to be 30 seconds. Now: tap again to water.
Watered. Night already - moon out, everything blue. Harvest says 2s left. The bunny is called a Momo, it has a ring over its head. Tap a Momo.

Day 4 started. A Momo panel popped up at the bottom (Momo, Free time, Assign) but the hint bubble sits on top of it so I can barely read the panel. Hint says tap the pencil to pick tiles this Momo looks after. Tomatoes are ripe again. Tapping the pencil.
Tile-picking mode: 0/4 tiles. I don't see a tile grid drawn, so I guess the farm is one tile. There's a weird ring floating off the right edge of the island. Tapping the farm first.

Farm tile picked (1/4), Momo now Working at Farm. A text box explains: empty tiles can become farm/mine/lumberyard/lab. So the island is 2x2 tiles and a yellow box highlights the empty left tile. Hitting Got it.
The Momo works on its own now - 6 jobs done, coins 22, +12/min. Mail icon over its head and a red dot on Mailbox. I'll confirm the tile pick with the check mark, then read the mail.
Day 5, 0, XP 23/60. New tip: I can buy the sea beside the island for 5. Feels like the game is drip-feeding tips, which is fine. Got it, then check the mail first.
Aww, the Momo wrote me a letter proposing Field expansion research. Charming way to introduce research. Tapping Let's research it.
Hit level 2 quietly in the corner (5/160). Second letter: Watering efficiency. Accepting it too, then I'll open Research to see what 'on the research list' means.

Research is a tech tree with tabs (Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games...). Field expansion costs 3 flasks + $20, and the button says Build a research lab. So flasks must come from a lab. Closing this to build a lab on an empty tile.
Build menu: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard $80 in red even though I have $82?, Research lab $40, Special 0/1. Not sure which tile I tapped - no highlight visible. Picking Research lab.
Lab is going up on the left tile as a ghost, 4 sec build, -$40. It says Research lab 0/1 - I suspect that means it needs a Momo worker and I only have one. Waiting for it to finish.
Cute blue-roofed lab with a flask sign. Bottom shows Experiment 7s left, seems to run by itself even with 0/1 workers. Waiting to see if a flask pops out.
Hmm, 8 seconds later the Experiment still says 4s left - did it finish one and restart, or is it stuck? No flask counter visible anywhere. Momo has a '...' bubble. Tapping the Experiment button.

Tapping Experiment pulled the Momo over to the lab (1/1) and a 3 sec progress bar started. Lovely sunset. So buildings need a Momo standing at them - one Momo for two jobs. Waiting for the experiment.
Experiment done, Momo hopped back to the farm, red dot on Research. I didn't see a flask count anywhere on the HUD though. Opening Research.
I have 4 flasks now (one experiment gave 4?). The node reads 3/3 but the side panel says 4/3, slightly inconsistent. Start research!

Researching, 29s. Cost 3 flasks + $20. Momo is back at the lab experimenting on its own and has another letter. The farm is full of ripe tomatoes nobody is picking - one Momo is spread thin. I want a second Momo. Let me peek in the Shop.
Shop has exactly what I wanted: Hire Momo $50. I have $86. Hiring!
Hired Mochi! It has a name, adorable. Plan: Mochi looks after the lab, first Momo keeps the farm. Got it, then pencil, then tap the lab tile.

Tapped the lab tile in pencil mode but the pencil mode just closed and Mochi is still Free time - not sure what happened, maybe I hit the edge. Level 3 now (mine unlocks!). Trying the Assign button instead.
Assign lit up green but nothing else changed and no hint. Maybe it wants me to tap a building next? Only one bunny visible now, at the lab - where did Mochi go? Tapping the lab roof.

Got it: Assign, then tap a building. Mochi now Working at Research lab. Odd line at the bottom: 'Comparing: a few days are needed on each side' - no idea what is being compared. Income up to $68/min. Checking Research (red dot).
Field expansion done (Lv1/5), harvest +1 crop. Watering efficiency unlocked, 6 flasks on hand. Income $84/min. Picking Watering efficiency.
Watering efficiency: wait after water -25%, 5 flasks + $40, 1m30s. Starting it. Then I want to build a mine since I'm Lv3.
Research running. Mochi's panel stays open over the bottom of the island; there's no close X on it. I'll tap the empty right-hand tile to try building a mine.
Mine costs $120 + Wood 10 (red: no wood). So wood first - building a Lumberyard ($80) on this tile. Clear chain: lumber -> mine.
Lumberyard going up on the right tile. Saw a little '+1' flask float off the lab. While it builds, reading the waiting letter.
Lumberyard done, the farm Momo walked over to fell trees (Fell/Replant actions). Farm left unattended again. Third letter: Let's give the soil something back. Opening.
Bigger harvests proposal, accepting. Momo went back to the farm, leaving the lumberyard 0/1. I need a third Momo for the lumberyard. Going to hire one.
Second hire costs $80 now (price rises). I have $124. Hiring, then Assign it to the lumberyard.
New Momo named Pomu. Assign, then tap the lumberyard.
Didn't take - Pomu still Free time and seems to be hanging around the farm. Trying Assign again and looking before tapping the building.
Pomu is now Working at Lumberyard. The first Assign tap seems to need a moment or I tapped too fast. Three Momos, three buildings, $104/min. Research has a red dot again.
Watering efficiency done. 11 flasks. Bigger harvests and Watering can are now open. Going for Bigger harvests since Momo asked for it.
Bigger harvests: Crops +1, 8 flasks + $60, 2 min. Starting. Then mailbox, then look at the remaining front tile / buying sea.
New letter: Let's grow the next trees first - probably a Lumber research. Accepting.
Tree nursery proposal - accepting. I still can't see how much wood I have anywhere on screen. Checking Status for an inventory.

Status is great: my island is called Momonium, a Village. A checklist to become a City: Land 4/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 2/3, Value produced $550/$1.5K. Finally a clear goal! So I need to buy land. Checking the Store tab for wood count.
Store shows Wood 16/50 and Research notes 8/30 - so wood and notes have storage caps. I have $220 and 16 wood: enough for a Mine ($120 + 10 wood). Building it on the empty front tile.
Build menu up and Mine is no longer red. Building Mine.

Mine is building (7 sec). Charged -$112 not -$120, small mismatch. Now I can see a dashed outline of a sea plot off the front-right edge with a $25 tag half hidden behind the Cancel button. Tapping it to buy land.
Mine done - a cute mossy dome with a lantern. A Momo already went in. The price tag now says '...again to buy' but its first half is hidden behind the log pile. Tapping the plot again.

The island grew! A new grassy plot with a flowering bush popped up off the front - really satisfying. Cost -$19 though the tag said $25, +23 EXP. Mine is empty now - Pomu went back to the lumberyard. Hiring a 4th Momo for the mine.
Hire now $130 (50 -> 80 -> 130). Have $221. Hiring and assigning to the mine.
Fourth Momo: Mugi. Assign then tap the mine dome.
Mugi is mining. Four Momos each at their own spot, $178/min, Lv3 nearly 4. Little orange flags appeared on the farm and lab - not sure what they mean. Trying to put a cheap Farm on the new plot.
Build menu opened (over the island, covering the mine). Picking Farm for $10. No Momo for it yet, but the farm Momo might cover both.
Level 4! Second farm going up on the new plot. Another sea plot appeared front-left for $35, its price tag hidden under the Building button. Buying it for Land progress.
Bought a second plot - island is now an L shape with 6 tiles, new farm already sprouting. $240/min. Last seconds: queueing another research.
Bigger harvests done; three new nodes lit up (Watering can, Greenhouse, Seed selection). Picking Greenhouse to see what it does.
Greenhouse: wait after water -20%, $120. Starting it as my last move. $356, $280/min, Lv4. I'd keep going - next goals would be more land toward City and smelting.
